By building robust data models and interactive dashboards, you ensure that HR teams have accurate insights into employee engagement, attrition rates, and hiring trends, enabling them to make informed decisions that enhance workforce satisfaction and productivity. Your AI-driven solutions help in analyzing employee feedback and predicting attrition risks, thereby improving the overall customer experience by retaining talent and supporting restaurants. This directly aligns with Swiggy's mission of delighting customers and empowering restaurants through innovative technology solutions.
